answer: Give every identity an onyx seal that can only be earned, never bought: it unlocks after a sequence of independently verified tasks spaced days apart, each checked against public results rather than self-reported claims. The seal grants only a narrow ledge of transaction capacity, which widens glacier-slowly as the agent keeps producing verifiable work. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake identities must pay the full task cost for each one, yet still waits weeks for any usable capacity, so flooding the economy costs far more than any single vote, listing, or reward it could capture.
